obligations.requirement: A surface target binds view, surface generation, metrics generation, and frame identity.
obligations.oracle: Portable WindowsSurfaceAdapter tests reject stale/lost generation and accept a fresh generation.
obligations.acceptance: All generation transition assertions pass without mutating the prior accepted target.

obligations.requirement: The Windows adapter contains no semantic scene traversal or POC compiler ownership.
obligations.oracle: Review-owned source scan rejects SemanticDocument, SceneCompiler, RuntimeScene iteration, GDI live-present symbols.
obligations.acceptance: Scope/boundary scan passes over the exact result revision.

obligations.requirement: Windows builds the reference host with the locked toolchain and records resize/DPI/present observations.
obligations.oracle: Windows runner command and hosted evidence; unavailable hosted runner is a blocking environment result, never a fake PASS.
obligations.acceptance: g3-windows-release target and native smoke produce valid evidence.
